text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While conducting a dance lesson with
Mejiro
Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sorry, can you stop the music?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Do you even have to ask? I'm not doing
it right at
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't know why, but I can't seem to
dance the
way I want to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to repay all the fans supporting
me, but
there's no way I can do that with
this lackluster
dance...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to repay all the fans supporting
me, but
there's no way I can do that with
this lackluster
dance...
Don't sell yourself short!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wha? P-Pearl?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fear not! I'm here to blow away those
itty-bitty
worries of yours!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well, let's get dancing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait... You mean, you're going to dance
too?!
I-I...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Of course I am! C'mon!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
U-um... Your dancing is so bold and
gorgeous,
and dazzling!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But those are all qualities I lack...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I can't ever seem to get things right
when I
dance... It doesn't feel like I can
convey anything
with my dancing.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That may be true... but it may also not
be true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Our performances ride the airwaves from
living
rooms here in Japan, to the other
side of the
world... and all the way to
outer space!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: With so many people watching us, there's no way none of them feel anything from our concerts.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Just like how you said my dancing is
perfect,
someone out there might be
saying the same
thing about yours.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The possibilities are endless! You have
to be more
optimistic!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: More optimistic? ...You think even my dancing could be perfect to someone out there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Okay, Pearl. I'll keep trying.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's because she finally starts
believing in
her own potential, but
Mejiro Dober's dancing
becomes sharper
than before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I really appreciate your help today. I
don't know
how to thank you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to do that. Though, if
you want to
thank someone, thank the
people you want to
express your
feelings to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But... there are so many of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The people around me...
choice_data_list: 見える範囲からやっていこう

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
J-just so you know, that category
doesn't include
you at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Then I guess I have to start with the
person
closest to me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to keep practicing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to keep practicing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober continues with her dance
lesson,
and...

text_block_list.name: Younger Students
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Dober's dancing! She looks so
dignified and
powerful... and sooo cool!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She polishes her dancing into something
that can
convey her feelings to others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You mean... I should make my dancing
famous
around the world?

text_block_list.name: International Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhh! Dober! Look over here! Dance
for us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A-as if! There's no way I can do that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's far too embarrassing. There's
no way I
can do that...
choice_data_list: なら、もっと練習しないとな
なら、もっと練習しないとね

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I mean! I'm talking about
the
mental hurdle here!
choice_data_list: なら、もっと練習しないとな
なら、もっと練習しないとね

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm glad you're so confident in my
skills, but
the mental hurdle is more of
the problem here...
choice_data_list: うん。精神も鍛えないとな！
うん。精神も鍛えないとね！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... How do I get through to you?
What I'm
trying to say is...
choice_data_list: うん。精神も鍛えないとな！
うん。精神も鍛えないとね！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's not what I... Wait... Maybe it is?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Losing to my persistence, Mejiro Dober
continues
with her lesson and improves
the precision of her
dancing.
